After the blockbuster launch of "Madden NFL 27" in August, Apple Arcade will add "two puzzle games beloved by players" to its ad-free gaming platform in September.

Block Blast!+ and "Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+" will join Apple's gaming subscription service in September.

Apple announced that the September Arcade update will bring two brand-new puzzle games to the platform: Block Blast!+ and "Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+". Both games will arrive on Apple Arcade starting Thursday, September 3.

Judging from gameplay footage, Block Blast!+ is especially suited for players seeking a Tetris-style experience.

On the other hand, "Art of Fauna" has a slower pace, featuring more leisurely, nature-inspired artwork.

Like all games on Apple Arcade, there are no ads and no in-app purchases — subscribing to Apple Arcade gives you unlimited access to all content.

Apple also emphasised that, starting from tomorrow, new content will continue to roll out on Arcade throughout August:

You can read the full announcement here.

Apple Arcade offers an ad-free gaming experience with no in-app purchases, priced at US$6.99 per month after a one-month free trial. Through the Family Sharing feature, one subscription account can support up to five users.

Every Apple One bundle subscription plan also includes Apple Arcade.
